title: Underlying Lean Graph of Libraries

semanticFidelityRoundTrips.graphLabel: Semantic fidelity: source -> Lean -> blind reconstruction -> review
semanticFidelityRoundTrips.authority: Lean-native evidence records compiled with the library and emitted as public declaration leaves
semanticFidelityRoundTrips.protocol: original text -> Lean -> blind Lean-only reconstruction -> ASPBE slotwise semantic delta -> independent review
semanticFidelityRoundTrips.display: the audit module imports the mathematical branches it checks, so generated import edges connect theorem branches to the system-evidence module and its clickable audit leaves
semanticFidelityRoundTrips.repairPolicy: a repair is stored separately as a proposal and never overwrites the preserved original statement
semanticFidelityRoundTrips.claimBoundary: compilation validates the audit data and its invariants; it does not by itself prove natural-language logical equivalence or accept a proposed source correction

libraryFactorizationProfile.authority: read-only derived view; never replaces Lean source, declarations, imports, or checker replay
definitions: S_t: transitive support of selected target t
r(v): number of selected targets whose support contains node v
I = sum_t |S_t| = sum_v r(v): expanded support incidences
P_share = sum_v binom(r(v),2) = sum_{s<t}|S_s intersect S_t|: pairwise sharing mass
libraryFactorizationProfile.antiGaming: metrics remain a vector; node minimization or fan-out maximization alone is not a valid optimization objective

futureEvidenceUpgrade: export theorem-level dependencies from elaborated Lean proof terms
apply the same factorization definitions to theorem support DAGs
record evidence layer and target policy with every historical metric snapshot
notYetClaimed: automatic proof that two natural-language statements are logically equivalent
automatic acceptance or mutation of source theorem text from a repair proposal
